answer: Attention-Backed Session Ledger: each session identity must periodically answer a fresh challenge derived from a live mesa of concurrent agents, and answers are scored by latency and coherence; whisper-level low-effort replies decay. A gale of cheap duplicate identities dilutes each one's share of the shared attention pool, so sustaining N sybils costs N times the real-time monitoring and response work, with no payoff unless genuine attention is spent.
